Subject: HIPAA onboarding checklist & deployment eligibility — follow-up

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today — great to learn more about NovaCare's use case for patient note summarization and prior-auth assistance. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we can get procurement and security aligned: 

Recap (high level)
- PHI scope you described: patient identifiers, visit summaries, some device-generated vitals. No image/medical DICOM files.
- Volume: ~200k tokens/day initially; spikes up to ~1.2M tokens/day for batch processing.
- Primary requirement: must be HIPAA-covered; need a BAA in place.

Redwood HIPAA posture (short)
- SOC 2 (Type II): currently in progress; we maintain internal controls and have a SOC 2 summary available. Full Type II report expected Q1 2027.
- BAA: Redwood provides a Business Associate Agreement for PHI workloads. BAAs are supported for Dedicated and Private (VPC / on-prem) deployments.
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (customer VPC or on-prem) — these provide network isolation, customer-managed keys, and audit log access. Our standard hosted public API (shared capacity) is not eligible for PHI under our default hosted plan.

Recommended next steps
1) I'll share our SOC 2 summary and a BAA draft (attached). Please have your security and legal review and send any redlines. (Neha will own the contract thread.)
2) Priya can scope the integration and provide an architecture checklist for Dedicated vs Private (networking, KMS, ingress controls). Can you confirm which deployment you'd prefer to evaluate first?
3) Please fill out our vendor security questionnaire (link below) or send your standard SQ. That will help us provide more concrete controls evidence.

Deliverables I attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (2pp) and a BAA draft (docx). Also linking our vendor questionnaire form.

Timeline notes: if you choose Dedicated, typical spin-up time for a minimal reserved pool is 2–3 weeks once contract and capacity commit are in place; Private (VPC) tends to be 3–5 weeks depending on network approvals.

If helpful, we can schedule a short technical sync with Priya and your infra/security lead later this week.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Emily — quick answers and additional context below.

1) Hosted public API and PHI
- Our standard shared-hosted API is NOT approved for production PHI processing under our standard hosted plan. We can make exceptions only in constrained pilot scenarios with contractually-scoped protections, but that requires an engineering review and explicit acceptance from our security team. For procurement/shortlisting, please assume Hosted = not eligible for PHI.

2) SOC 2 timing and interim evidence
- We expect the SOC 2 Type II report to be issued by the end of Q1 2027 (target: March 2027). In the meantime we can share an internal SOC 2 controls summary (attached) and an executive attestation letter that describes scope and status. Neha will coordinate getting the attestation and a proposed SOC 2 timeline you can share with internal reviewers.

3) Dedicated vs Private — quick cost/timeline posture
- Dedicated: Minimum commitment typically 4 GPUs reserved; spin-up 2–3 weeks once PO/contract signed. Cost drivers: GPU type (A100 vs H100), reservation term (monthly vs annual), and whether you want burst capacity.
- Private (VPC): Minimum similar to Dedicated but includes network egress, peering setup, and optionally customer-managed KMS. Timeline 3–5 weeks depending on network approvals.

4) BAA and questionnaire
- Attached: redwood-baa-draft.docx (please redline). Also included a link to our short vendor security questionnaire. If you prefer, send your standard questionnaire and we will complete it.

Next steps proposed
- Emily: confirm preferred deployment (Dedicated or Private) for procurement packet.
- NovaCare security/infra: send preferred questionnaire or let us know and we'll send our hosted questionnaire link.
- Redwood: Neha will pick up contract redlines; Priya will schedule a technical onboarding session once deployment choice is confirmed.

I'll include a procurement ballpark: for a small Dedicated starter (4x A100 equivalent), expect $35k–$55k/month at list pricing (discounts available for annual commit). We'll follow up with a more precise estimate after Priya scopes model size and token volumes.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call with procurement/legal if that helps speed things up.

Marcus Lin
